meta.name: ultimate-browsing
meta.description: Escalation skill for blocked or hard-to-reach web access — load it when a normal browse/fetch is blocked (WAF, 403, Cloudflare, JS-only render, login-gated, or a platform a generic fetcher cannot read). Tiered router: TIER 1 insane-search (headless extraction + WAF bypass via curl_cffi TLS impersonation, yt-dlp, Jina Reader, public APIs, Playwright real-Chrome fallback); TIER 1.5 agent-reach (platform-native readers for Chinese and social platforms: Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, Bilibili, V2EX, WeChat, plus Twitter/Reddit/LinkedIn/GitHub); TIER 2 Chrome stealth (CloakBrowser stealth Chromium + agent-browser CDP for clicks, forms, screenshots, video, cookie login). Triggers: blocked site, bypass bot detection, cloudflare/WAF bypass, scrape, stealth browser, import cookies, fill form, screenshot, play youtube, xiaohongshu, douyin, weibo, bilibili, v2ex, wechat article, podcast transcript. NOT for simple searches (use web-search) or plain fetches (use webfetch).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绕过网页封锁，抓取任何受限内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到网站封锁或需要抓取动态渲染的页面
copy.tagline_en: Bypass web blocks and scrape any restricted content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often encounter blocked websites or need to scrape dynamically rendered pages

howto.what: 装上后，遇到普通方式打不开的网页时，Claude 会改用多级方案：先无头抓取绕过拦截，再走平台专用接口（如小红书、抖音等），最后用隐身浏览器模拟真实操作（点击、截图、填表）。
howto.when: 当常规抓取失败、页面被 WAF/403/Cloudflare 拦住、需要 JS 渲染或登录后可见，或要读取小红书、抖音等平台内容时触发。

say.text: 这个网页被 Cloudflare 拦住了，帮我绕过并抓取内容。
say.note: 会启动无头抓取，尝试提取正文。

say.text: 帮我把这个小红书帖子的文字提取出来。
say.note: 会走小红书专用读取接口。

say.text: 用隐身浏览器打开这个页面，截图保存。
say.note: 会启动 CloakBrowser 真实渲染并截屏。

howto.what_en: After installation, when a page cannot be opened normally, Claude switches to a tiered approach: headless extraction to bypass blocks, platform-specific readers (e.g., Xiaohongshu, Douyin), then a stealth browser for real interactions (clicks, screenshots, forms).
howto.when_en: Triggers when normal fetch fails, a page is blocked by WAF/403/Cloudflare, requires JS rendering or login, or when reading content from platforms like Xiaohongshu or Douyin.

say_en.text: This page is blocked by Cloudflare; help me bypass it and fetch the content.
say_en.note: Launches headless extraction to grab the text.

say_en.text: Extract the text from this Xiaohongshu post.
Open this page in a stealth browser and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Starts CloakBrowser for real rendering and a screenshot.
